# netbox_contact_role (Data Source)

Retrieves a single contact role from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_contact_role" "example" {
  name = "Technical"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the contact role. At least one of `name` or `slug` must be given.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the contact role. At least one of `name` or `slug` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the contact role.
- `created` (String) When the contact role was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the contact role, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the contact role.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the contact role was last changed.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the contact role.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
